astrology.title: The Techniques Behind ZiWei Path
astrology.subtitle: We integrate ancient wisdom to remove the blind spots of single-method readings

ziwei.name: Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗數)
ziwei.origin: Origin: China, with possible Taoist origins
ziwei.concept: A complex astrological star-based system. It places a set of 108 stars (like Zi Wei, Tian Ji, Tai Yang) into 12 'palaces' (areas of life such as Wealth, Career, Relationships, Health) on a personal chart wheel.
ziwei.describes: Extremely detailed and specific life events, relationships, career paths, and fortunes. It is more event-oriented and granular than Ba Zi. Practitioners interpret the star combinations in each palace to predict timing and nature of occurrences.
ziwei.analogy: A detailed life simulation or fate movie script. Where Ba Zi gives you the terrain, Zi Wei Dou Shu shows the specific characters (stars), the scenes (palaces), and the plot twists you are likely to encounter.

bazi.name: Ba Zi (八字) - Four Pillars
bazi.origin: Origin: China (based on Chinese Cosmology and the I Ching)
bazi.concept: A destiny calculation map based on your exact birth time (year, month, day, hour). Each pillar is represented by a Heavenly Stem and an Earthly Branch, forming the 'Eight Characters' (Ba Zi). It's essentially a snapshot of the cosmic energy present at your moment of birth.
bazi.describes: Your inherent potential, personality traits, strengths, weaknesses, and the major cycles of luck throughout your life. It analyzes the interactions of the Five Elements (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) in your chart to determine balance and imbalance.
bazi.analogy: Your life's blueprint or DNA. It shows the type of 'terrain' you were born to navigate—mountains, rivers, forests—and the tools you were given.

qimen.name: Qi Men Dun Jia (奇门遁甲)
qimen.origin: Origin: China, historically used for military strategy and divination
qimen.concept: A dynamic, time-space model of the universe at any given moment. It involves complex layers of the Eight Trigrams, Nine Stars, Eight Doors, and Eight Spirits arranged on a cosmological chart (the Dun Jia plate).
qimen.describes: Not primarily about personality. It is a tactical tool to find the most advantageous direction, time, and strategy for a specific action (e.g., starting a business, negotiation, travel). It reveals the hidden 'doors' (opportunities) and how to 'shield' (Dun) yourself.
qimen.analogy: A cosmic weather and terrain map for strategy. Like a general using a real-time satellite map to find the best path to victory, it helps you align with cosmic currents for success.

western.name: Western Zodiac
western.origin: Origin: Mesopotamia, developed in the Hellenistic world
western.concept: Based on the position of the Sun relative to 12 constellations (signs) at your birth, divided by the seasons (the Tropical Zodiac). The most common form is the Sun Sign horoscope.
western.describes: Personality archetypes, psychological drives, and potential life themes. A full natal chart includes planets, houses, and aspects to give a nuanced picture of an individual's character and life patterns.
western.analogy: A psychological portrait. It focuses on the inner self, motivations, and character development within the context of universal archetypes (the Hero, the Communicator, the Transformer, etc.).

chinese.name: Chinese Zodiac (生肖)
chinese.origin: Origin: China, based on ancient legend
chinese.concept: A 12-year cycle, where each year is represented by an animal (Rat, Ox, Tiger, etc.) and its associated attributes. Your sign is determined solely by your lunar birth year.
chinese.describes: Broad personality traits, general compatibility with other signs, and fortune trends for the year (during Chinese New Year forecasts). It is a popular, simplified system.
chinese.analogy: A cultural personality type or mascot. It's an accessible, folkloric system that gives a general flavor of a person's nature or a year's energy, much less detailed than Ba Zi or Zi Wei Dou Shu.

whatIs.title: What is ZiWei Path?

whatIs.paragraph1: Our system integrates multiple traditional Chinese metaphysical systems including Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗數), Ba Zi (八字), and Western astrology to give you comprehensive insights into your life path, relationships, career, and fortune.
whatIs.paragraph2: Unlike traditional fortune-telling that requires expensive consultations with masters, ZiWei Path makes these ancient wisdom accessible to everyone through AI technology, delivering instant, accurate analyses in multiple languages.
